snippet.title: Order Automatica Gameplay Trailer - The MIX Fall Game Showcase 2025
snippet.description:
Step into the ritual. ⚔️🕯️ Order Automatica is a single-player roguelike auto-battler played on a 3×3 grid. Recruit strange allies, harness occult relics, and master endless strategies as you fight to keep your last candle burning.

This gameplay trailer gives you a first look at the dark pixel-art world, eerie soundtrack, and the strategic battles that define Order Automatica.

Wishlist now and join the Order:
👉 Check out Order Automatica on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2105840/Order_Automatica/
